dlcs.name: Realms Beyond
dlcs.desc: Cross the veil between the sacred and the forgotten. Destiny is a coin tossed in the Underworld. Realms Beyond opens the doors to the mystical and the forbidden. It is a journey from the depths of oblivion to the heights of enlightenment. In this pack, the arena becomes a mythological stage where time itself seems to have stopped.

dlcs.name: Cyber Corrupt
dlcs.desc: Where technology meets its end, your tactical advantage begins. This expansion pack doesn't just change the visuals; it introduces Interference and Attrition mechanics designed for players who prefer control and confusion tactics.
